headline: Public hearing on a conditional use permit for a personal fitness studio at 381 Main Street, Unit 2.
summary: Nick Braley, applicant for FMP Realty, LLC, asks for a conditional use permit for a personal fitness studio at Map 109 – Lot 7. Other items include a review of developments of regional impact and two appointments.

November 6, 2026 
AMENDED AGENDA 
 
To: NCPB Members 
 
From: Planning Staff 
 
Re: Regular Meeting and Public Hearing November 19, 2026 
 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua Planning Board will occur on Thursday, 
November 19, 2026 at 7:00 PM at the Nashua City Hall located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH. The public 
may submit their comments in advance of the meeting via email pb@nashuanh.gov or by mail (please make 
sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4PM on November 18, 2026. Letters should be addressed 
to City of Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. Plans can be viewed online 
starting November 16, 2026 at  https://nashuanh.portal.civicclerk.com/. The public may request access via 
Zoom; contact the Planning Department before 4PM on November 18, 2026, for a link. 
 
A. Call to Order 
B. Roll Call 
C. Approval of Minutes – October 1, 2026 
D. Communications 
E. Report of Chairman, Committee, & Liaison 
F. Executive Session 
 
NEW BUSINESS – CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS 
A26-0203  FMP Realty, LLC (Owner), Nick Braley (Applicant) requesting Conditional Use Permit 
approval for a personal fitness studio. Property is located at 381 Main Street, Unit 2. Map 109 
– Lot 7. Zoned A-Urban Residence (R-A). Ward 6. 
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
1. Review of tentative agenda to determine developments of regional impact. 
2. Appoint board member to Nashua Regional Planning Commission Executive Committee 
3. Appoint board member to Historic District Commission 
DISCUSSION ITEMS 
 
None  
 
 
Planning & Zoning 589-3090
Fax 589-3119
WEB www.nashuanh.gov
NONPUBLIC SESSION 
The Planning Board will need to make a motion to enter into a Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-A:3, II (e) 
for consideration or negotiation of pending claims or litigation which has been threatened in writing or filed 
against the public body. 
NEXT MEETING: December 3, 2026 
 
ADJOURN
